evidence: Static: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile (diff empty; template-controlled). It pins every grading component: FROM node:22-bookworm-slim + python:3.12-slim (L1-4, tags not digests, template choice); npm -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281 (judge CLI for REWARDKIT_JUDGE=claude-code), @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (L16-22); harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (L31); Chromium installed by the Playwright CLI bundled with @playwright/mcp into /opt/playwright-browsers and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium (L33-39), matching every judge.toml mcp arg --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium; procps/util-linux give setsid/setpriv/kill used by test.sh L104-111; python3 serves probe_ready, score.py and restart_mcp.py (functional judge.toml command=/usr/local/bin/python3). App runtime deps: solution/app/package.json and server.js require only express 5.1.0 + better-sqlite3 12.4.1 (+ node builtins), the same pins as environment/Dockerfile L9-12 and the brief (integration.md: 'Express and better-sqlite3 are already installed globally and found through NODE_PATH'); verifier sets NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (L9) and test.sh passes it under env -i. Deterministic check-runtime-deps-in-both-images applied by hand: both images install express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 -> pass. Measured (this review, 2026-10-09, docker build of the frozen task/tests dir as qc-r22-kittle-verifier:r1, image sha256:a0e302d8fdf4..., layers cache-matched cw-editor-verifier pins): node v22.23.2, Python 3.12.14, claude 2.1.281, harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7 with the agents.py bypass patch applied (grep count 1), playwright-mcp 0.0.79, /usr/local/bin/chromium -> /opt/playwright-browsers/chromium-1237/chrome-linux64/chrome (Chrome for Testing 152.0.7977.8); better-sqlite3 loads natively (sqlite 3.50.4) under NODE_PATH; /tests copied with sha256 test.sh bd68259276ca..., score.py 13de2b388596..., restart_mcp.py 03c1426f00e4..., app_context.md bbb905d7b170... matching the frozen files. With --network none, golden installed as solve.sh does, frozen test.sh lines 1-193 sourced: LAUNCHED_READY, /api/health 200, node /app/server.js running as user nobody; headless Chromium (--no-sandbox, the judge's executable path) loaded http://localhost:3000/ status 200, title 'Kittle & Rowe · Matter chat', sign-in form rendered; generated app-restart.sh exit 0 ('app-restart pid=178 ready=1') and the page rendered again after restart. playwright-mcp with the exact judge.toml args answered MCP initialize (Playwright 1.63.0-alpha) and tools/list (24 tools); rewardkit --help exposes --output and --max-concurrent-agent used by test.sh run_suite. Counterexamples tried: (a) conforming alternative that npm-installs an extra package (e.g. ws) into /app/node_modules: test.sh copies /app (L92) and refuses only symlinks escaping /app/node_modules; both images are Debian bookworm + Node 22 so a native addon built in the agent image loads in the verifier - no false fail; (b) broken app passing: not applicable to this row (image capability, not app correctness). Residual risk (why risk=true): no full configured rewardkit run with the live claude-code -> OpenRouter z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx judge in this image has been recorded for this candidate (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... absent'; the 8 Oct scripted golden used cw-editor-verifier:current, not an image built from this task). So 'can grade end-to-end with the judge' is not measured; only every component and the launch/restart/browser path are. Base images use floating tags (template-controlled; not a task defect).
